requirements.statement: Bind asset-structure findings to the exact glTF 2.0.1 scene, node, mesh, material, accessor, buffer, and image semantics selected by the external overlay.
requirements.evidence: Asset manifest, version, validator receipt, and source lock.

requirements.statement: Record every selected extension and do not infer support or portability outside the declared runtime and extension evidence.
requirements.evidence: Extension list, runtime support evidence, and unknown ledger.

applicability_rule: Applicability is evaluated from external jurisdiction/entity/activity/data/version/effective-date evidence; this file never stores project facts.
exception_rule: Exceptions require an external primary-source or authority-corpus reference and remain requirement-level mappings.
